title: Pool Machine Config
description: Defines a machine in the agent farm pool: its SSH connection, default project, and available slots.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor validation.

schema_version.description: Pool config schema version. Bumped by farmslot update migrations; files without it are treated as version 0.

machine.description: Unique machine identifier. Used as prefix for slot IDs.

project.description: Default project for all slots on this machine. Slots can override with their own 'project' field.

platform.description: Default platform for all slots. Slots can override. Common values: ios, android, chrome-extension, web, cli, backend.

host.description: Hostname or IP for SSH connections. Use 'localhost' or '<machine>.local' for local machines.

claude_path.description: Absolute path to the Claude CLI binary on this machine.

codex_path.description: Absolute path to the Codex CLI binary on this machine.

opencode_path.description: Absolute path to the OpenCode CLI binary on this machine.

cursor_path.description: Absolute path to the Cursor Agent CLI binary on this machine.

grok_path.description: Absolute path to the Grok CLI binary on this machine.

android_home.description: Path to Android SDK. Required for Android platform machines.

dispatch_cmd.description: Shell command template to launch an agent in a slot. Supports {repo}, {runner}, {runner_path}, {claude_path}, {codex_path}, {opencode_path}, {cursor_path}, {grok_path}, {model}, {task_file}, {task_prompt}, {effort}, and {adb_serial} placeholders.

recycle_cmd.description: Shell command to recycle app state (e.g., clear app data). Overrides project hooks.recycle when set.

domain.description: Default domain overlay for dispatches from this machine. Slot-level domain and task-level domain override it; used for fixture compose (DOMAIN), {{domain}} substitution, and domain template variants.

session_prefix.description: Prefix applied to every tmux session name registered on this machine (e.g. 'dev' -> session 'dev-mm-1'). Keeps dev/prod (or multi-install) sessions from colliding and lets you eyeball which install a session belongs to. Omit for today's unprefixed session names.

repo_url.description: Git remote URL for cloning repos on this machine.

notes.description: Free-form notes about this machine's setup or quirks.

tmux_workers.description: Optional inventory/control policy for general tmux worker panes on this machine. Omit to expose every tmux pane.

slots.description: Available work slots on this machine. Each slot = one repo clone + one device + one agent.

include.description: Optional allowlist. When present, only matching panes are listed/controllable unless excluded.

exclude.description: Optional blocklist. Exclude wins over include.

tmuxWorkerRule.description: All fields in one rule must match. String values are glob patterns supporting * and ?.

slot.description: A single work slot: one repo clone, one device/simulator, one tmux session.

project.description: Project this slot belongs to. Overrides machine-level 'project'.

platform.description: Platform for this slot. Overrides machine-level 'platform'.

enabled.description: Whether this slot is available for dispatch. Default: true.

mode.description: Slot mode. 'dispatch' = available for automated dispatch. 'custom' = reserved for manual use.

repo.description: Absolute path to the repo clone for this slot.

branch.description: Default git branch for this slot. Used by prepare-slot.sh.

domain.description: Default domain overlay for this slot. Overrides machine-level 'domain'; task-level domain overrides both.

app.description: App name within a monorepo project.

lifecycle.description: Current lifecycle state. Managed by scripts, not manually edited.

task.description: Current task file name, or null if idle.

resources.description: Resource instances for this slot. Keys match resource IDs in project.json resources.
